answer.command: cd {tree} && TZ=America/Los_Angeles TREE="$PWD" npx vitest run --root ../check
answer.because: With the host set to Los Angeles, head shifts the parse results by the gap between the context zone and the host zone: parse("10:00","HH:mm",ref,{in: tz("Asia/Singapore")}) with a reference of 20:00 on Apr 6 in Singapore returns 01:00 on Apr 7 in Singapore (17:00Z) instead of 10:00 on Apr 6 (02:00Z), and a full-date parse against a UTCDate reference returns 17:00Z instead of 10:00Z, while base passes both.
